description: Search CWE weaknesses by all text tokens, exact platform or consequence vocabulary, abstraction, status, mapping usage, view membership, a recorded taxonomy mapping (taxonomy name or entry ID such as CERT C ARR30-C), or a CVE that MITRE cites as an observed example. Text tokens match at word starts or camelCase humps; tokens of at least four Unicode letters also match after exactly one un or mis prefix at a word start (trusted finds untrusted), with possible spelling coincidences. Search other compounds such as deserialization as written; text never matches an entry ID or CVE. Omit filters to browse; categories and groupings are excluded. Each result carries MITRE’s mapping usage, which says whether the entry may be used to map a vulnerability, and, under a taxonomy or CVE filter, every mapping or observed example that matched. Results order by all tokens in the name or in one recorded alternate term such as XSS, then all in the description, then any other match, then numeric ID. Description previews contain the first sentence; use cwe_get_weakness for complete sections. Follow nextCursor for remaining matches.

abstraction.description: Exact CWE abstraction level; blank means unset.

consequenceImpact.description: Exact consequence impact; discover with cwe_list_reference topic filter_values.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation returned by this tool.

filter.description: All whitespace-separated tokens must match the name, a recorded alternate term, the description, or the extended description, each at a word start or camelCase hump (dos finds ReDoS). Tokens of at least four Unicode letters also match after exactly one un or mis prefix at a word start (trusted finds untrusted); spelling coincidences can match. Other compounds such as deserialization must be searched as written. Blank means unset.

language.description: Exact platform language name or class; discover with cwe_list_reference topic platforms.

limit.description: Maximum page size; capped at 100 and a 24,000-byte response budget with disclosure.

mappingUsage.description: Exact MITRE vulnerability mapping usage, such as Allowed or Allowed-with-Review; discover values with cwe_list_reference topic filter_values.

observedCveId.description: CVE ID such as CVE-2021-44228, in any case; matches the weaknesses MITRE cites it on as an observed example, not other CVE-to-CWE assignments such as NVD’s. Blank means unset.

status.description: Exact weakness status; discover with cwe_list_reference topic filter_values. A status only categories or groupings carry matches nothing. Omission includes all statuses, including Deprecated.

taxonomyEntryId.description: Entry ID a weakness taxonomy mapping records, such as ARR30-C or A1, in any case and with any whitespace runs; matches only the whole recorded ID. With taxonomyName, both must hold on the same mapping. Blank means unset.

taxonomyName.description: Exact taxonomy name a weakness mapping records, such as CERT C Secure Coding or ISA/IEC 62443; discover values with cwe_list_reference topic filter_values. Matches any mapping in that taxonomy, including one without an entry ID.

technology.description: Exact platform technology name or class; discover with cwe_list_reference topic platforms.

viewId.description: CWE view ID such as CWE-1000 or 1000, from cwe_list_reference topic views; matches the weaknesses its recorded members reach within the view, or that its source filter selects for a filter-defined view. Blank means unset.

name: cwe_search_weaknesses

taxonomyEntryId.description: Entry ID as a weakness mapping records it, or the whitespace-collapsed input when none does.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_filter`: Unsupported dynamic vocabulary or unknown or wrong-type view. `invalid_cursor`: Cursor is incompatible with inputs or catalog. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same normalized query.

descriptionPreview.description: First complete sentence of the CommonMark source description.

mappingUsage.description: Source vulnerability mapping usage, such as Allowed or Prohibited; absent when not recorded.

matchedObservedExamples.description: Every observed example of this weakness that cites observedCveId, in source order; present only when it applies.

matchedTaxonomyMappings.description: Every taxonomy mapping of this weakness that taxonomyName and taxonomyEntryId match, in source order; present only when one of them applies.

truncated.description: Whether a page omits remaining matches.

title: Search CWE weaknesses
